comment: The draft correctly supports federated and hybrid models. It should explicitly recognise research institutions, clinical-research platforms, laboratories and biorepositories as authorised source applications that retain operational custody of their records.

public.text: The draft correctly supports federated and hybrid models. It should explicitly recognise research institutions, clinical-research platforms, laboratories and biorepositories as authorised source applications that retain operational custody of their records.
public.suggestedRevision: Add clinical-research management systems, LIMS, biorepository information-management systems and research-data repositories as recognised functional applications and data contributors within a federated DPI-H ecosystem.
